'''2011 Bespin Regionals Brady Moore DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Brady
* '''Deck name:''' No Stats Take 2
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
